title: Learning to Use AI for Learning: Teaching Responsible Use of AI Chatbot to K-12 Students Through an AI Literacy Module
reasoning: The paper focuses on teaching AI literacy and responsible engagement (such as avoiding cheating) to K-12 students. While it mentions the ethical use of AI as a learning goal, the study evaluates student prompting performance and the accuracy of an AI auto-grader rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks within the LLM itself.
